title: zlib FDICT and preset dictionary identifiers
summary: When the FDICT bit of FLG is set, the header is followed by a four-byte DICTID, and decoding requires a preset dictionary matching the identifier.
detail: DICTID is the Adler-32 checksum of the dictionary bytes. Simply skipping these four bytes does not restore the missing dictionary.
boundary: Ordinary zlib streams without FDICT have no DICTID field.
relevance: Distinguish between "dictionary required" decoding errors and compressed data truncation.
